item.title: Blaney ends Reddick's streak to give Team Penske a Phoenix weekend sweep
item.description: AVONDALE, Ariz. (AP) — Ryan Blaney completed a Team Penske sweep at Phoenix Raceway by winning the Cup Series race Sunday — a victory that denied Tyler Reddick a fourth consecutive win to start the NASCAR season.
